workouts.title: Fan Bike
workouts.description:
3 Sets:
Tabata Fan Bike *
Rest 4:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
* "Tabata" = 8 Sets of :20 Work, :10 Rest
- For many people on 2.0, this is the third time you will have done this workout. If you have done this piece before, try to hold the same paces or go faster than the last time you did this.
- Ideally, the average wattage for each Tabata increases with every set.

- Complete each set as fast as possible.

NOTES:
- Set up a 3-5ft section on the floor, or however far you can confidently walk everytime you kick up, and get as many reps of this distance as you can in eight minutes.

workouts.title: Run
workouts.description:
Running Intervals:
PRIMER.
3:00 @ Add your Personal Record below/1000m
Rest 2:00
MAIN SET.
1000m @ Add your Personal Record below/100m
400m @ Easy Pace
600m @ Add your Personal Record below/100m
400m @ Easy Pace
200m @ Sprint
400m @ Easy Pace
400m @ Add your Personal Record below/100m
Rest 1:00
400m @ Add your Personal Record below/100m or faster
NOTES:
- This is a bear of a workout, because there is no rest.
- Run the 400m easy intervals at a pace that allows you to hold on to your faster paces, even if that means walking on the easy intervals. The focus of this workout is to be moving the whole time and still hit your fast pace intervals.

workouts.title: Tempo Pause Squat
workouts.description:
Tempo Pause Squat
Build To A Heavy Set of 5 (RPE 8), 12x1 Tempo
-then-
3x5 @ 12x1 @ 90% of Above
*Rest 2-3 Minutes Between Sets.
NOTES:
- "12x1" means that you will take :01 to descend, :02 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- Hit a weight that leaves about two reps in the tank.
Go by feel, taking at least three sets to build to weight once you are warm.
- Keep the pause at full depth. Stand straight up from the bottom of each rep with no bounce.
Bench Press
Build to a Heavy 3 @ RPE 8
+
2x3 @ 85% of Heavy 3
Rest 2:00 Between Sets.

workouts.title: Spin Bike Intervals
workouts.description:
Spin Bike Intervals
PRIMER.
3 Sets:
1:00 @ Add your Personal Record below
1:00 @ Add your Personal Record below :30 @ 90-100 RPM
*No Rest Between Sets.
Rest as needed, then...
MAIN SET.
10 Sets:
1000m @ Fast Pace / RPE 9
*Rest 1:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- RPE 9 means that you are pushing each set as hard as you can while still being able to recover for the next. There should be no more than a :10 spread between your fastest and slowest sets.
- Try to keep all efforts between 85-90 RPM.
- If you are using a Bike Erg, use this link to set your monitor and track your results via ErgData: https:// workout.ergdata.com/shared/raq2izz2
